selection_rule: Exactly three symmetric development variants and three asymmetric held-out variants are frozen. No substitutions, split moves, opening changes, thickness changes, grammar expansion, or extra rows are permitted after production or audit begins.

candidate_producer.admission_boundary: Future output is experimental only and cannot add an executable manifest, corpus/provider input, training input, runtime resource, or active case-library record without separately selected production, review, and promotion workpacks.

q01_required_facts: one rectangular outer solid with length, width and height
one full top planar face declared as the only opening
one uniform inward wall thickness strictly smaller than half each outer span and height
one connected shell with a bottom wall
q01_rejections: opening on a side or bottom face
contract.q02_allowed_action: Create exactly one rectangular solid, select its complete top face, then apply one inward OCCT thick-solid/shell operation with the frozen uniform thickness.
preconditions: the removed face is exactly the top face
semantic_invariants: the only opening is the complete top face
four side walls have uniform wall_thickness
outer bounding box equals the declared rectangular base
no through-bottom opening or detached solid exists
unsupported_conditions: multiple openings, side or bottom openings, variable thickness, ribs, fillets, chamfers, drafts, booleans, internal partitions, multi-solid output, generic shell recognition or generic B-Rep-to-sequence inference

geometry: existing geometry replay gates against each deterministic reference output
editability: positive wall-thickness and outer-dimension mutations preserve strict preconditions and opening semantics
semantic: one solid, complete top opening, uniform bottom/side wall thickness, unchanged outer bbox and no through-bottom
hash_stability: two clean-directory normalized STEP hashes for every frozen row
split_isolation: shell_symmetric only in development and shell_asymmetric only in held_out

negative_controls: wrong_opening_face: remove one side face; reject by top-opening semantic invariant
missing_opening: retain the closed box; reject by opening invariant
bottom_breakthrough: remove top and bottom faces; reject by bottom-wall invariant
nonuniform_thickness: alter one wall thickness; reject by uniformity invariant
split_leak: place a shell_symmetric ID in held_out; reject before production
